newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX April Brent up after API reports crude draw.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX April Brent up after API reports crude draw.

text.p: April Brent crude futures were higher in late trading on Wednesday on the back of a surprise draw in crude stocks in the United States.
April Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.66 per barrel, up 16 cents from London which settled on Tuesday up 58 cents at $19.50.
Brokers said the API data was enough to spark some short covering after the slump in prices over recent weeks. However, they said they expected increasing resistance up to $20.00 on the front month.
NYMEX crude was last traded at $20.81 on ACCESS, up 15 cents from New York, but down from an intraday high of $20.96 after an attempt to break $20.00 resistance.
API data showed an unexpected fall in crude stocks of 7.6 million barrels, or 4.1 million excluding the isolated U.S. west coast. A build of 2.8 million barrels had been expected.
A draw in gasoline stocks of 1.3 million barrels also supported prices after a build of 875,000 barrels had been expected.
